{{Top|leg}}
'''Infrared Imaging Modules''' were inbuilt systems included in [[GTU]]'s [[AV-1 power armor|AV-1]] series of [[Power armor/Legends|power armor]]. The module allowed the wearer a vision setting based on heat with a range of 200 [[Meter/Legends|meters]].
